keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Agadez row; the songhai-empire dossier carries Aïr from 1515). "Oral history of the Aïr describes the foundation of the sultanate around 1405 by local Tuareg tribes"; the page gives no extent or area, so a 150 km disc at Agadez stands for the core. Tuareg confederacies moved south into the Aïr in the 18th century (undated outline).

ledger.note: c. 1405: local Tuareg tribes found the Sultanate of Agadez in the Aïr. "Oral history of the Aïr describes the foundation of the sultanate around 1405 by local Tuareg tribes"; infobox "Establishment of the Sultanate: 1405".

region.text: Agadez and the Aïr massif (the page gives no extent)

ledger.note: c. 1516-7: Songhai conquers Agadez. "The Agadez Sultanate was later conquered by the Songhai Empire in 1500"; "Circa 1516-7 the Songhai Empire successfully campaigned against Agadez". The Songhai dossier dates the gain to 1515.

region.text: Agadez and the Aïr massif (the page gives no extent)

ledger.note: 1591: Agadez regains its independence. "After the defeat of the Songhai kingdom in 1591, the Agadez Sultanate regained its independence." Between these years it was also "occupied by Kanta's Kebbi empire during their conflicts with the Songhai" and broke away from Kebbi in the late 16th century after Kanta's death.

notes:
Sultanate of Agadez (Aïr), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Sultanate of Agadez (the title "Sultanate of Aïr" did not load).

Dates: founding 1405 (infobox and oral history; not c. 1449 sometimes given); Songhai conquest 1500 or c. 1516-7 (the page gives both; the songhai-empire dossier has 1515); French administration 1906 (not 1900). Occupations: Songhai 1516-1591 (the page's independence "after the defeat of the Songhai kingdom in 1591") and Kebbi (undated: "occupied by Kanta's Kebbi empire", broke away "in the late 16th century after Kanta's death"; the kingdom-of-kebbi dossier carries it at confidence 1). The page has no extent, no rulers list and no Bornu tribute. The Aïr itself is a disc at Agadez (150 km). Gazetteer: Agadez place exists.
